_approach: Rack toms (high/mid/low) accent the second half of every second bar in a short descending fill-like figure, a common trance decoration used to mark 4- or 8-bar phrase boundaries without breaking the main kick/hat groove underneath. Otherwise the standard uplifting skeleton (909 kick, offbeat open hat, 16th closed hat, clap 2+4). (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
